2607.03572.title: Teacher Supervision over Representation Equivalence Classes
2607.03572.paper_summary: Knowledge distillation is usually framed as a choice of what to match in the teacher - its logits, hidden features, or sample relations - which presupposes that the teacher's representation has absolute coordinates to match. It does not: a pretrained representation is identifiable only up to an orthogonal-and-isotropic-scaling equivalence class, so a student should learn the teacher's equivalence class, not its features. The organizing fact is that capability is the teacher's output function, a class invariant that factors through the quotient by the class action, so an objective recovers capability exactly when it is defined there. This makes absolute feature matching ill-posed, and admissible supervision a matter of targeting class invariants (Gram structure, CKA, principal subspaces) or aligning coordinates first, unifying feature matching, relational distillation, alignment, and grafting in one geometric account. We validate our framework on Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.1. A restoration study recovers a corrupted model's representation (CKA ~ 0.99) but not its capability, and an ablation isolates the cause: output-function (logit) matching drives capability, while matching hidden representations aligns geometry without restoring function. Recovery is confined to the corpus-covered region, and a graft study confirms that boundary overlap predicts transplant success but is necessary, not sufficient.
2607.03572.paper_summary_zh: 知識蒸餾通常被框架化為選擇在教師中匹配什麼——其邏輯值、隱藏特徵或樣本關係——這假設教師的表示具有絕對坐標可供匹配。事實上並非如此：預訓練的表示僅在正交和各向同性縮放等價類中可識別，因此學生應該學習教師的等價類，而不是其特徵。組織事實是能力是教師的輸出函數，一個類不變量，通過類作用的商來因子化，因此當客觀在那裡定義時，恰好恢復能力。這使得絕對特徵匹配變得不適定，而可接受的監督則是針對類不變量（Gram 結構、CKA、主子空間）或首先對齊坐標，將特徵匹配、關係蒸餾、對齊和嫁接統一在一個幾何賬戶中。我們在 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3.1 上驗證了我們的框架。一項恢復研究恢復了損壞模型的表示（CKA ~ 0.99），但未恢復其能力，而一項消融實驗則隔離了原因：輸出函數（邏輯值）匹配驅動能力，而匹配隱藏表示則對齊幾何而不恢復功能。恢復僅限於語料庫覆蓋的區域，而一項嫁接研究確認邊界重疊預測移植成功，但這是必要的，而非充分的。
2607.03572.author: Sang Il Han et.al.
